elements.name: Move the ribbon from the top to both sides and back

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked on the left
the ribbon is docked at the top with the 3D Model tab selected
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Left from Docking Positions
the ribbon tabs are arranged vertically along the left edge
the 3D Model command groups are stacked beside the tabs
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
the user chooses Right from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser is visible on the left of the viewport
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
the user chooses Top from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged horizontally above the viewport
the model browser remains visible to the left of the viewport
